t: Tipu's Tiger is an eighteenth-century mechanical toy, made for Tipu Sultan, ruler of the Kingdom of Mysore. The painted wooden tiger is mauling a near life-size British man. Inside, mechanisms move the man's hand, make him wail, and make the tiger grunt. A flap on the tiger's side folds down to reveal the keyboard of a small pipe organ with eighteen notes. Tipu Sultan ruled Mysore from 1782 to 1799, and fought British forces in the Anglo-Mysore Wars.
